name: repomap-workspace
description: repomap monorepo: Rust engine (crates/), npm packages (packages/), graph UI (ui/), docs (docs/).

scripts.build:ui: bun build ui/src/main.ts --minify --target=browser --format=iife --outfile=crates/repomap/assets/app.js && cp ui/src/style.css crates/repomap/assets/app.css
scripts.build: bun run build:ui && cargo build --release -p repomap
